name: a1-gallery
description: Ground design work in real websites — search 1,100+ live sites by style, font, colour and section, and read the type scale, spacing and palette measured off the page.

interface.longDescription: Search a hand-curated gallery of 1,150+ real websites by style, category, technology, font and colour. Each result has the live URL, its tags and a screenshot. Search 6,000+ captured sections such as heroes, pricing tables and FAQs by what they say, and read the colours, type sizes, spacing and radius measured off the live page. Browse full-page captures by page type, find font pairings in use on real sites, and see who built each site. All tools are read-only and work with a free A1 account.
defaultPrompt: Find dark fintech landing pages built with Webflow.
How big are hero headings on agency sites?
Show me pricing sections that mention a free trial.

positive.description: Search websites by style and technology
positive.prompt: Find dark fintech landing pages built with Webflow.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching websites from the gallery with live URLs, tags and screenshots.

positive.prompt: Show me pricing sections that mention a free trial.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns pricing sections whose extracted text mentions a free trial, each with a screenshot and measured design tokens.

positive.prompt: How big are hero headings on agency websites?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the spread of hero heading sizes across agency sites in the gallery, with the sample size.

positive.prompt: Show me the sections on the first result and the colours its hero uses.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that site's captured sections in page order with hex colours and their roles.

positive.prompt: Which fonts pair well with Inter on real websites?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns fonts used alongside Inter on gallery sites, with example websites.

negative.prompt: Save this website to my A1 boards.
Generate a new logo for my startup.

negative.description: Out of scope: sites outside the gallery
negative.prompt: Scrape the full HTML of example.com for me.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. All tools are read-only.

publication.release_notes: First release: 17 read-only tools for searching websites, sections, pages, fonts and creators, plus measured design tokens. Skills for design reference, section rebuilds and setup.
